news.headline: Forgent CEO, CFO, a director and the general counsel buy shares after the post-earnings slide
news.summary: Form 4 filings dated November 16 show CEO Gary Niederpruem bought 16,000 shares at about $20.85-$21.59 (about $335K), CFO Amy Ard 14,617 shares at $20.52 (about $300K) and director Neel Bhatia 9,366 shares at $21.26 (about $199K); General Counsel Tyson Hottinger also reported buying 11,800 shares. It is the first cluster of open-market insider buying since the IPO, and the shares gapped up on November 17 after the filings.

news.headline: TD Cowen keeps Buy on Forgent, lowers price target to $55 from $76
news.summary: A day after fiscal Q1 results, TD Cowen kept its Buy rating but cut its target to $55 from $76, pointing to FY2027 bookings timing. Even after the cut, the target sits well above the low-$20s share price.

news.headline: Baird, Oppenheimer, KeyBanc, Bernstein and Jefferies cut Forgent price targets after Q1; ratings kept
news.summary: Baird cut to $38, Oppenheimer to $40 from $60 (Outperform kept), Bernstein to $33 from $48 on its margin outlook (Outperform kept), Jefferies to $36 from $47, and KeyBanc also lowered its target on valuation, joining JP Morgan and TD Cowen. The average 12-month target is now about $44, roughly double the low-$20s share price, so the cuts reset valuation rather than the growth thesis.

news.headline: Forgent shares slide despite Q1 beat as FY27 guidance midpoint trails estimates
news.summary: Despite record revenue of $478.6M (+69%) and adjusted EPS of $0.24 vs. $0.20 consensus, the stock fell as the raised fiscal 2027 revenue range of $2.45B-$2.65B had a midpoint below Street expectations. The stock was already down about 42% over the past month amid the data-center sell-off.

news.headline: Forgent Power CEO Sees AI Lab, Hyperscaler Orders Building Through 2028 – Firm Raises Fiscal 2027 Earnings Guidance
news.summary: On the Q1 call, management said two hyperscaler customers have moved past master supply agreements to signed product agreements and a third hyperscaler has entered qualification. The CEO expects AI-lab and hyperscaler orders to keep building through 2028.

news.headline: Forgent Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Results Above High End of Guidance; Raises Full-Year Outlook on Strong Commercial and Operational Execution
news.summary: Fiscal Q1 revenue rose 69% to a record $479M with adjusted EBITDA of $105M (21.9% margin), net income of $55M and $136M of operating cash flow, all above the top of guidance. Forgent raised FY2027 guidance to $2.45-2.65B revenue and $587-637M adjusted EBITDA, with backlog covering 100% of the revenue guide.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q2 2027 results
catalysts.detail: First quarterly check against the raised FY2027 guide of $2.45-2.65B revenue and $587-637M adjusted EBITDA; watch order intake and backlog conversion.

catalysts.label: Columbus office ramp
catalysts.detail: New 90,000 sq ft Columbus, Ohio office adding 85 jobs in support functions.

catalysts.label: Tijuana Powertrain expansion online
catalysts.detail: Expected to raise total revenue capacity to about $5.8B.

pulse: Forgent beat on Nov 12 with record fiscal Q1 revenue of $479M (+69%) and adjusted EBITDA of $105M, and raised its FY2027 guide to $2.45-2.65B revenue, with backlog already covering the full-year guide and hyperscaler orders building through 2028. The stock still slid to around $20 because the guide midpoint trailed estimates, prompting a wave of price-target cuts (JPMorgan $35, TD Cowen $55) though ratings stayed positive. The CEO, CFO, a director and the general counsel bought roughly $1M of stock combined on Nov 16, a notable vote of confidence that sparked a gap-up on Nov 17; the next hard checkpoint is fiscal Q2 results around February.
